What is Sistem pendaratan otomatis?

In this glossary, Sistem pendaratan otomatis refers to: Integrated avionics that guides aircraft from glide-slope capture through flare and rollout without pilot control inputs.

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Sistem pendaratan otomatis aktif, memonitor lampu status fail-passive dan memverifikasi flare capture."

Definition

Integrated avionics that guides aircraft from glide-slope capture through flare and rollout without pilot control inputs.

Operational example

Automatic landing system engaged, monitoring fail-passive status lights and verifying flare capture.
